lines: Abnormal uterine bleeding after initiating hormone replacement therapy
The patient is a 57-year-old female with complex atypical endometrial hyperplasia and metastatic breast carcinoma on endocrine therapy who presents with abnormal uterine bleeding.
She has been perimenopausal for the past year and began hormone replacement therapy (HRT) 4 months ago for severe hot flashes and night sweats.
Initially, she was prescribed a combination of estrogen and progesterone, but she discontinued the progesterone component after experiencing mood swings.
She now reports several weeks of intermittent heavy bleeding.

lines: Persistent fatigue, unintentional weight loss, difficulty sleeping, and loss of interest in hobbies

She presents with a 3-month history of persistent fatigue, 10-pound unintentional weight loss, and difficulty sleeping.
She reports feeling "down" most of the day, nearly every day, and no longer enjoys gardening, which was previously her favorite hobby.
She also mentions feeling worthless and has trouble concentrating on tasks.

encounters.cc: Persistent right chest wall pain with minimal relief from ibuprofen

lines: Persistent right chest wall pain with minimal relief from ibuprofen

The patient is a 58-year-old female with metastatic breast carcinoma status post right modified radical mastectomy who returns to the oncology clinic for evaluation of persistent right chest wall pain.
She describes the pain as a constant dull ache with intermittent sharp twinges that worsen with movement.
She rates her pain as 5 out of 10 on average but states it can reach up to 7 out of 10 on her worst days.
She has been taking ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily with minimal relief.
She denies any recent trauma or injury.
